Ovrtone 0.4.0 (beta)
====================

Installing over an earlier Ovrtone keeps your settings, themes, presets, templates, plugin scan,
favourites and tags: they live in %APPDATA%\ovrtone, which the installer and uninstaller leave
alone. Close Ovrtone before installing; the installer offers to close it for you.

This is a beta: save often, and send what you find.

New in 0.4.0
------------

- Fit to Tempo follows every tempo change, also inside a region: each beat of the audio stays on
  a beat of the song through tempo changes and ramps.
- Cycle (the loop region) has its own strip at the top of the ruler and its own header row; it
  stays outlined when off.
- Typing Keyboard (Ctrl+K) is on the control bar; right-click there to choose the mode buttons.
- Audio Editor tab beside the Piano Roll; the Piano Roll ruler moves the playhead.
- Melodyne and other ARA plugins get the song's tempo map and time signatures.
- Key commands work while the pointer is over the editors, except the keys the Piano Roll uses.
- Ghost notes, grid lines and control bar icons show in every theme. Pattern clips are named
  after their track.

Not yet: effects on spatial buses, outputs beyond the main stereo pair, Project Alternatives
and the Project Audio browser.

New in 0.3.1
------------

- Fit to Tempo: right-click an audio region. It takes the BPM from the file name or listens for
  it, then stays locked to its bars through every tempo change. Follow Tempo By picks Stretch
  (pitch kept) or Resample (speed and pitch change together). The region shows its BPM and mode.
- Live tempo following: audio fitted to the tempo is now stretched by the engine as it plays,
  so a tempo change is heard straight away, with no stretched copy to wait for. Stretch keeps
  the pitch; Resample changes speed and pitch together. Before, a loop at a steady tempo could
  keep its own speed, or be stretched twice. A region already affected needs Fit to Tempo again
  (or dragging in again). A tempo change inside a fitted region uses the tempo at its start.
- Audio Track Editor: select an audio track and the bottom pane shows its region, the whole
  file with the played part lit. Drag the lower handles to trim the start or end, the upper ones
  for fades, click to move the playhead. Gain, Reverse and Fit to Tempo are in its bar.
- Audio File Editor (from the Audio Track Editor): normalize, gain, fades, silence, reverse and
  trim the file itself, on a copy; your original file is never changed.
- Channel Rack: the step under the playhead lights up while a placed pattern plays. Press a step
  and drag along the row to paint steps (FL style); right-click drag erases. A channel given
  steps shows up on the Playlist by itself, wherever the pattern is placed (or at the playhead).
  Selecting a pattern clip on the Playlist opens its pattern in the rack.
- Dropping a sample always asks what it becomes: a hit at that bar (short samples), an audio
  clip, a Channel Rack channel, a step pattern, a Piano Roll channel, or the sound of the track
  under it. This includes a single file dragged in from File Explorer.
- Messages at the top of the window clear after a few seconds; click one to dismiss it.

New since 0.2.3
---------------

Workflow
- Organize Mix Session (Mix menu): recognises each track by its name (Kick, 808, Lead Vox, BGV...),
  colours it by group, sorts the tracks and gives each group a bus. Check the groups, change any,
  then Organize. The naming rules can be edited.
- Open sessions from other DAWs (File > Open): DAWproject (Bitwig, Studio One, Cubase), REAPER,
  Ableton Live and Ardour, with tracks, clips, tempo and markers. Pro Tools through its Session Info
  as Text, and Logic in part. A log lists what could not be carried over.
- Smart Tool (Snap menu): the top half of a region selects, the bottom half moves, the edges trim,
  the top corners fade.
- Spot (right-click a region), pre-roll and post-roll (right-click the count-in button), and clip
  gain lines on audio regions (Snap menu > Clip Gain Lines).
- Alt-drag a region's end to time-stretch it; loops that follow the tempo stay locked to their bars
  through tempo changes, and a new high-quality stretch mode (Complex).

Spatial audio
- Speaker layouts from stereo up to 9.1.6, VBAP panning, distance, X/Y/Z, snap, divergence, LFE
  filter, downmix to smaller layouts, speaker setup with test noise, and spatial buses.
- The panner and the renderer have a new look; the renderer is on Stereo Out's strip.
- Any track can be placed in 3D in a stereo project too (heard on headphones).
- Exports: ADM BW64 (7.1.4, or a 7.1.2 bed with up to 118 objects), multichannel WAV, binaural
  and Ambisonics. Measured heads (SOFA files) for headphones.

Mixing
- Ovrtone's own effects on Stereo Out, before its plugins.
- Stereo Out stays at the mixer's right edge (or left: Settings > Display).
- A Frequency Shifter effect; copy, paste and duplicate effects between strips.
- Reference tracks, kept out of exports.

Engine
- Plays more ahead of the sound card while nothing is live, so heavy sessions have more time
  (Settings: Render ahead during playback).
- Effects run in blocks; the mix uses the processor's vector units.
- Window > Performance shows the load, the slowest callbacks, dropouts and the costliest tracks.

Your work
- Each save keeps a backup beside the project (Settings > General sets how many); File > Revert to >
  Project History opens any of them. A project that will not open offers its newest backup.
- The crash-recovery copy's interval is set in Settings > General.
- Aftertouch and pitch-bend lanes in the Piano Roll; mono and normalised exports; MIDI clock out.

Display
- High contrast and a keyboard focus ring (Settings > Display). Track icons are off unless turned
  on there.

Known limits
- Logic projects open in part only (the audio files, each on its own track from the start); Pro
  Tools' text export has no tempo and does not say where a trimmed clip starts. AAF is not read yet.
- Spatial buses take no effects yet, and tracks are stereo (no multichannel audio files).
- Render ahead delays Play and Stop by about 50 ms while it is on.

Send what you find to the person who gave you this installer.
